description: The complete set of things the Nexo WebView is allowed to do. §4.5 requires starting from empty and growing only deliberately. Network calls still happen in Rust and are exposed, if at all, as narrow commands — nothing here reaches the network. Filesystem access is limited to the native Open/Save dialogs (the user picks the path, Explorer-style) plus writing into common user folders, and the clipboard is readable as well as writable — read was added when the app took over the right-click menu inside text fields, because a text field's menu without Paste is not one; the cost is recorded in docs/THREAT-MODEL.md. The window permissions are the minimum a frameless window with a custom titlebar needs (§7.3) — drag the window, and the three Windows caption buttons.
